entries.title: Alisa Weilerstein’s Cello
entries.summary: “ ‘It’s a bird, it’s a plane!’ people cried. No, just a cello on a moonlit flit.”

entries.title: Our Fall Issue Cover: Elizabeth Glaessner’s Big Head
entries.summary: “The title kind of teases the painting. It’s a tiny person painting a giant head, which sounds like it could be about the ego.”

entries.title: Sexless in the City: The Second Life of Cynthia Buchanan’s Maiden
entries.summary: “ ‘She was looking for a man,’ Cynthia Buchanan writes of the virgin’s quest. ‘She sure was looking for some man.’ ”

entries.title: Ernest Hemingway, Unlocked: The Sun Is Still Rising
entries.summary: “Everybody my age had written a novel and I was still having a difficult time writing a paragraph.”
